abyssal_blood.description: Abyssal Blood: Once per day when the barbarian enters a rage, she can choose to grow one size category larger than her base size (as enlarge person, even if the barbarian isn't humanoid). (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser abyssal blood)
abyssal_blood.name: Abyssal Blood

accurate_stance.description: Accurate Stance: The barbarian can focus her strikes. She gains a competence bonus on melee attack rolls and thrown weapon attack rolls. @B-4f1-barbarian.
accurate_stance.name: Accurate Stance

air_totem.description: Air Totem: Once per rage, the barbarian can move for 1 round as if affected by air walk. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser elemental totem (air))
air_totem.name: Air Totem

ancestor_totem.description: Ancestor Totem: The barbarian's insight bonus to her chosen skill increases to +4. The barbarian can now select any skill to receive this bonus, even a Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skill or a skill that requires patience or concentration; if she selects such a skill, she can use it even while raging. (Prerequisite: Lesser ancestor totem, 6th-level barbarian)
ancestor_totem.name: Ancestor Totem

animal_fury.description: Animal Fury: While raging, the barbarian gains a bite attack. If used as part of a full attack action, the bite attack is made at the barbarian's full base attack bonus -5. If the bite hits, it deals 1d4 points of damage (assuming the barbarian is Medium; 1d3 points of damage if Small) plus half the barbarian's Strength modifier. A barbarian can make a bite attack as part of the action to maintain or break free from a grapple. This attack is resolved before the grapple check is made. If the bite attack hits, any grapple checks made by the barbarian against the target this round are at a +2 bonus.
animal_fury.name: Animal Fury

armor_ripper.description: Armor Ripper: While raging, you gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to sunder with any of your natural attacks. (Prerequisite: Wereboar-kin or associated with wereboar-kin)
armor_ripper.name: Armor Ripper

aryzuls_curse.description: Aryzul's Curse: When raging, the barbarian emanates a 5-foot-radius aura of radioactivity. Each round that another creature begins its turn within this aura, it takes a cumulative -2 penalty to Strength (Fortitude negates, DC = 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + her Constitution modifier) for the duration of the rage. A creature's Strength penalty from this ability cannot exceed the barbarian's class level. At 12th level: The barbarian can choose to create a 10-foot-radius aura of radioactivity when she begins her rage.
aryzuls_curse.name: Aryzul's Curse

atavism_totem.description: Atavism Totem: The barbarian gains ferocity. (Prerequisite: Lesser atavism totem, 6th-level barbarian)
atavism_totem.name: Atavism Totem

auspicious_mark.description: Auspicious Mark: The barbarian has been marked by the spirits, as indicated by an impressive tattoo, scar, or birthmark she possesses. By spending 2 rounds of rage, the barbarian can call upon the spirits' favor. Using auspicious mark grants her a +1d6 bonus on one d20 roll she has just made. She can call on the auspicious mark after seeing the result of the d20 roll. (Once per rage)
auspicious_mark.name: Auspicious Mark

autumn_rage.description: Autumn Rage: The barbarian becomes a servant of the harvest. While raging, she gains a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to reposition or trip. She also gains this bonus on attack rolls to confirm critical hits. A barbarian can have only one season-themed rage power, choosing between spring, summer, autumn, or winter rage.
autumn_rage.name: Autumn Rage

battle_roar.description: Battle Roar: When the character successfully demoralizes an opponent using intimidating glare, he also deals 1d6 points of sonic damage to that opponent. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, intimidating glare)
battle_roar.name: Battle Roar

beast_totem.description: Beast Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains a natural armor bonus. @B-4f1-barbarian. (Prerequisite: Lesser beast totem, 6th-level barbarian)
beast_totem.name: Beast Totem

bestial_climber.description: Bestial Climber: While raging, the barbarian gains a natural climb speed equal to her land speed. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, raging climber)
bestial_climber.name: Bestial Climber

bestial_flyer.description: Bestial Flyer: While raging, the barbarian's fly speed increases by 10 feet and her maneuverability improves by one category. (Prerequisite: A fly speed (before raging,) raging flyer, 6th-level barbarian)
bestial_flyer.name: Bestial Flyer

bestial_leaper.description: Bestial Leaper: While raging, the barbarian can take a move action to move and can take her normal standard action at any point during the move. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, raging leaper)
bestial_leaper.name: Bestial Leaper

bestial_swimmer.description: Bestial Swimmer: While raging, the barbarian gains a natural swim speed equal to her normal land speed. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, raging swimmer)
bestial_swimmer.name: Bestial Swimmer

bleeding_blow.description: Bleeding Blow: When she uses her powerful blow rage power, the barbarian also deals bleed damage equal to her bonus damage with the powerful blow. This bleed damage bypasses damage reduction. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, powerful blow)
bleeding_blow.name: Bleeding Blow

bloody_bite.description: Bloody Bite: The barbarian's bite attack deals 1d6 points of bleed damage in addition to its other effects. (Prerequisite: Half-orc, either animal fury or a natural bite attack)
bloody_bite.name: Bloody Bite

bloody_fist.description: Bloody Fist: While raging, the barbarian may attempt to punch through an opponent's flesh and rip out one of its vital organs. In order to do so, the barbarian must confirm a critical hit against an opponent with a natural attack or unarmed strike. The barbarian deals damage as normal for a critical hit and the opponent must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's class level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) or take 1d4 points of Constitution damage as one of its vital organs is ripped free from its body. (Once per rage) (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian)
bloody_fist.name: Bloody Fist

boars_charge.description: Boar's Charge: While raging, when you hit with a gore attack as part of a charge, you automatically score a critical threat. You must still confirm the critical hit as normal. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, wereboar-kin or associated with wereboar-kin)
boars_charge.name: Boar's Charge

boasting_taunt.description: Boasting Taunt: While raging, the barbarian can incite a creature to attack her by making an Intimidate check to demoralize. If the check succeeds, the target is also shaken as long as the barbarian is visible and raging or until it makes a melee attack against the barbarian. The barbarian receives a +2 circumstance bonus on this check for every alcoholic drink she has consumed during this rage. This is a language-dependent mind-affecting effect, and it relies on audible components. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian)
boasting_taunt.name: Boasting Taunt

body_bludgeon.description: Body Bludgeon: While raging, if the barbarian pins an opponent that is smaller than her, she can then use that opponent as a two-handed improvised weapon that deals 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage, assuming the opponent is sized Small. Larger or smaller creatures used as a bludgeon deal damage based on their size using this base damage. A size Tiny creature deals 1d6 points of damage, a size Medium creature deals 1d10 points of damage, and so on.~~~The barbarian can make a single attack using the pinned opponent as part of the action she uses to maintain the grapple, using her highest attack bonus. Whenever the barbarian hits using the pinned opponent as a weapon, she deals damage to her target normally, and the grappled opponent used as a bludgeon also takes the same damage she dealt to the target. If the pinned opponent is unable to resist being pinned for any reason, the barbarian can use that opponent as an improvised weapon without grappling or pinning the opponent, until the creature is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, at which point the creature becomes useless as an improvised weapon. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian)
body_bludgeon.name: Body Bludgeon

brawler.description: Brawler: While raging, the barbarian is treated as if she has Improved Unarmed Strike. If she already has the feat, her unarmed strikes deal 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if she is Small).
brawler.name: Brawler

breathtaker.description: Breathtaker: The barbarian's blows take the air from her foes' lungs. While raging, whenever the barbarian makes a successful melee attack against an opponent that is holding its breath, in addition to any other effects caused by that attack, the opponent loses a number of rounds of breath equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier.
breathtaker.name: Breathtaker

cairn_linnorm_death_curse.description:
The character channels the power of a cairn linnorm. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of negative energy damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the curse of decay (Will negates)." prereq="8th-level barbarian"

Curse of Decay: Curse; save Will DC 10 + 1/2 the character's level + their Charisma modifier; effect Target takes 1 point of Con damage per day and ages at a rate of 1 year per day (eventually incurring all of the penalties of old age but none of the bonuses)
cairn_linnorm_death_curse.name: Cairn Linnorm Death Curse

calm_stance.description: Calm Stance: The barbarian can enter a state of calm. While in this stance, the barbarian doesn't gain any benefits from rage other than the temporary hit points, but she doesn't take any of the penalties from rage (including the penalty to AC and the restriction on actions she can take). Rounds spent in a calm stance still count against her total number of rounds of rage per day.
calm_stance.name: Calm Stance

celestial_blood.description: Celestial Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains resistance 5 to acid and cold. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser celestial blood)
celestial_blood.name: Celestial Blood

celestial_totem.description: Celestial Totem: While raging, the barbarian shines with a righteous light. This effect bestows upon the barbarian a halo of gleaming light that shines as if it were daylight and triggers an invisibility purge effect in the barbarian's square and each adjacent square. The invisibility purge only affects nongood creatures. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, lesser celestial totem)
celestial_totem.name: Celestial Totem

chaos_totem.description: Chaos Totem: While raging, the barbarian's form becomes infused with chaos. She gains a +4 bonus on Escape Artist checks and has a 25% chance to ignore extra damage from critical hits and sneak attacks. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser chaos totem)
chaos_totem.name: Chaos Totem

clear_mind.description: Clear Mind: A barbarian may reroll a failed Will save. This power is used after the first save is attempted, but before the results are revealed by the GM. The barbarian must take the second result, even if it is worse. This power can only be used once per rage. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian)
clear_mind.name: Clear Mind

come_and_get_me.description: Come and Get Me: While raging, the barbarian may leave herself open to attack while preparing devastating counterattacks. Enemies gain a +4 bonus on attack and damage rolls against the barbarian until the beginning of her next turn, but every attack against the barbarian provokes an attack of opportunity from her, which is resolved prior to resolving each enemy attack. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian)
come_and_get_me.name: Come and Get Me

contagious_rage.description: Contagious Rage: The barbarian howls during combat, agitating nearby fauna. Willing animals and magical beasts within 30 feet of the barbarian gain the benefits of the rage spell for as long as she maintains her rage. After the barbarian's rage ends, creatures affected by her rage are fatigued for the same number of rounds as the barbarian. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian)
contagious_rage.name: Contagious Rage

crag_linnorm_death_curse.description:
The character channels the power of a crag linnorm. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of fire damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the curse of fire (Will negates)." prereq="4th-level barbarian"

Curse of Fire: Curse; save Will DC 10 + 1/2 the character's level + their Charisma modifier; effect Target gains vulnerability to fire
crag_linnorm_death_curse.name: Crag Linnorm Death Curse

crippling_blow.description: Crippling Blow: When using her powerful blow rage power, the barbarian can forgo the normal bonus to damage (including any bleed damage granted by the bleeding blow rage power or similar boosts to the damage of the powerful blow rage power) and instead deals 1 point of ability damage to the target's Strength or Dexterity score for every four class levels the barbarian has attained. The target can attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) to halve this ability damage. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, powerful blow)
crippling_blow.name: Crippling Blow

cult_totem.description: Cult Totem: The barbarian can make an attack of opportunity against a creature within her reach who damages an ally of the barbarian with a melee attack. Only the enemy, not the barbarian's ally, needs to be within the barbarian's melee reach in order for the barbarian to make this attack of opportunity. Once the barbarian makes an attack of opportunity against a creature with this ability, she can't use this ability to make an attack of opportunity against the same creature for 24 hours. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser cult totem)
cult_totem.name: Cult Totem

daemon_totem.description: Daemon Totem: While the barbarian is raging, her melee attacks impose a temporary negative level on her opponent on a successful critical hit. After 1 hour, these temporary negative levels disappear automatically (without a saving throw). (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser daemon totem)
daemon_totem.name: Daemon Totem

deadly_accuracy.description: Deadly Accuracy: If the barbarian scores a critical threat when using her surprise accuracy rage power, she applies double the surprise accuracy bonus when rolling to confirm the critical. (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian, surprise accuracy)
deadly_accuracy.name: Deadly Accuracy

deathless_frenzy.description: Deathless Frenzy: While raging, you ignore the effects of being at 0 or fewer hit points until you have been at 0 or fewer hit points for 1 round, at which point the appropriate consequences for your current hit point total take effect. Even death can be postponed this way, potentially allowing you to survive if you receive sufficient healing before the round is up. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, wereboar-kin or associated with wereboar-kin)
deathless_frenzy.name: Deathless Frenzy

disemboweling_tusks.description: Disemboweling Tusks: While raging, when you confirm a critical hit with your gore attack, you deal 1d4 points of Constitution damage in addition to the normal damage for the gore attack. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, wereboar-kin or associated with wereboar-kin)
disemboweling_tusks.name: Disemboweling Tusks

disruptive.description: Disruptive: When raging, the barbarian gains Disruptive as a bonus feat. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, superstition)
disruptive.name: Disruptive

dissipating_rage.description: Dissipating Rage: When the barbarian rages, her feverish frenzy and hot breath burn or blow fog, smoke and similar effects away from her. The barbarian and creatures adjacent to her do not gain concealment from obfuscating effects like fog or precipitation. Magical effects that require more than a strong wind to dissipate are not affected by this rage power.
dissipating_rage.name: Dissipating Rage

draconic_blood.description: Draconic Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains resistance 5 against the chosen energy type and a +1 natural armor bonus. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser draconic blood)
draconic_blood.name: Draconic Blood

dragon_totem.description: Dragon Totem: While raging, she gains a +1 bonus on Perception checks and a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear, paralysis, and sleep effects. This bonus increases by +1 for each additional dragon totem rage power (such as dragon totem resilience and dragon totem wings) the barbarian possesses. (Prerequisite: Animal fury, intimidating glare, 6th-level barbarian)
dragon_totem.name: Dragon Totem

dragon_totem_resilience.description: Dragon Totem Resilience: While raging, the barbarian gains resistance to the energy type that is associated with her dragon totem - acid (black, copper, green), cold (silver, white), electricity (blue, bronze), or fire (brass, gold, red). This resistance equals double her current DR/- from her barbarian damage reduction class feature; this energy resistance increases by 2 for each dragon totem rage power she possesses, including this one. (Prerequisite: Dragon totem, 8th-level barbarian)
dragon_totem_resilience.name: Dragon Totem Resilience

dragon_totem_wings.description: Dragon Totem Wings: When a barbarian selects this rage power, the Fly (Dex) skill becomes a class skill for her. While raging and wearing medium or lighter armor, the barbarian can manifest a pair of spiritual dragon wings that grant her a fly speed equal to her base speed (average maneuverability). She can expend 2 rounds of her rage to instead use an immediate action to gain this fly speed. She can end her fly speed at any time, even when it is not her turn. Each round she spends raging and flying counts as 2 rounds of rage. Her ability to fly ends automatically when she ceases raging. (Prerequisite: Dragon totem, dragon totem resilience, 10th-level barbarian)
dragon_totem_wings.name: Dragon Totem Wings

earth_totem.description: Earth Totem: While raging, the barbarian can burrow through sand, loose soil, or gravel at a speed of 20 feet. This does not give the barbarian the ability to breathe underground. Loose material collapses behind the target 1 round after it leaves the area. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser elemental totem (earth))
earth_totem.name: Earth Totem

eater_of_magic.description: Eater of Magic: Once per rage, when a barbarian fails a saving throw against a spell, supernatural ability, or spell-like ability, she can reroll the saving throw against the effect (this is not an action). If she succeeds at the second saving throw, she is not affected by the spell, supernatural ability, or spell-like ability and gains a number of temporary hit points equal to the effect's caster level (in the case of spell or spell-like abilities) or the CR of the effect's creator (in the case of supernatural abilities). These temporary hit points last until damage is applied to them or 1 minute, whichever occurs first. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, superstition)
eater_of_magic.name: Eater of Magic

eclipsing_rage.description: Eclipsing Rage: While the barbarian is raging, the light level within 10 feet of her lowers by one step. She can't decrease the light level below normal darkness with this ability. Multiple barbarians with this rage power don't further reduce the light level. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian)
eclipsing_rage.name: Eclipsing Rage

elemental_blood.description: Elemental Blood: While raging the barbarian gains energy resistance 10 against the energy type chosen when she took lesser elemental blood. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser elemental blood)
elemental_blood.name: Elemental Blood

elemental_rage.description: Elemental Rage: While raging, all of the barbarian's melee attacks deal an additional 1d6 points of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). The type is chosen when the barbarian begins her rage. The barbarian can still use her lesser elemental rage power while using this rage power, but she must select a different energy type. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian,lesser elemental rage)
elemental_rage.name: Elemental Rage

elemental_stance.description: Elemental Stance: When the barbarian adopts this stance, she chooses an energy type (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). Her melee attacks deal 1 additional point of damage of the chosen type. At 8th level: This damage increases to 1d6 points. At 12th level: The barbarian's critical hits deal an additional 1d10 points of energy damage of the same type (2d10 if the weapon deals ×3 damage on a critical hit, 3d10 if the weapon deals ×4 damage on a critical hit). (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian)
elemental_stance.name: Elemental Stance

energy_absorption.description: Energy Absorption: While raging, the barbarian can absorb energy from a single attack of her chosen energy type once per rage. She does not make a saving throw against the effect but takes no damage from it, instead gaining 1 temporary hit point per 3 points of damage the attack would have inflicted. These temporary hit points last until the end of the barbarian's rage. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, greater energy resistance)
energy_absorption.name: Energy Absorption

energy_eruption.description: Energy Eruption: While raging, the barbarian can absorb energy from a single attack and unleash it upon her enemies. She does not make a saving throw against the effect but takes no damage from it.~~~At any point during the remainder of her rage she can unleash the stored energy as a breath weapon in either a 60-foot line or 30-foot cone. The breath weapon inflicts damage equal to the damage from the attack absorbed by the barbarian, but creatures within the area may make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Constitution modifier) for half damage even if the original effect did not allow a save. (Once per rage) (Prerequisite: 16th-level barbarian, energy absorption)
energy_eruption.name: Energy Eruption

energy_resistance.description: Energy Resistance: While raging, the barbarian gains resistance to one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) equal to 1/2 her barbarian level (minimum 1). The energy type is chosen when this rage power is selected and it cannot be changed. This rage power can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time is applies to a different energy type.
energy_resistance.name: Energy Resistance

enhance_venom.description: Enhance Venom: The barbarian adds her Constitution modifier to the DC of any poison she delivers using viper's kiss or viper's breath. (Prerequisite: Viper's kiss, viper's breath)
enhance_venom.name: Enhance Venom

erratic_charge.description: Erratic Charge: As part of the full-round action to perform a charge attack against a creature at least 20 feet away, the barbarian can move 5 feet in any direction before making the charge. This movement is not a 5-foot step and provokes attacks of opportunity as normal, and using this option reduces the maximum distance of the charge by 10 feet.
erratic_charge.name: Erratic Charge

fearless_rage.description: Fearless Rage: While raging, the barbarian is immune to the shaken and frightened conditions. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian)
fearless_rage.name: Fearless Rage

feast_of_blood.description: Feast of Blood: While raging, the barbarian may feast on the organs of her foes and absorb their power. After successfully ripping out a creature's vital organ, the barbarian may eat the organ within 1 minute of extracting it. Once the organ is consumed, the barbarian recovers a number of hit points equal to the Hit Dice of the organ's owner.~~~In addition, the barbarian gains any energy immunities or resistances the victim had, though the effectiveness of these resistances is halved (for instance, a barbarian who eats the heart of a creature with resist cold 10 would gain resist cold 5; energy immunities are reduced to resist energy 20). This energy resistance lasts for a number of rounds equal to half the Hit Dice of the creature whose organ was consumed. (Prerequisite: Bloody fist, 14th-level barbarian)
feast_of_blood.name: Feast of Blood

feasting_bite.description: Feasting Bite: When the barbarian confirms a critical hit with her bite attack, she regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt. Activating this ability consumes 1 round of rage. (Prerequisite: Half-orc, bloody bite, either animal fury or a natural bite attack)
feasting_bite.name: Feasting Bite

ferocious_beast.description: Ferocious Beast: While the barbarian is raging, her animal companion also gains the benefits of rage (including greater rage, mighty rage, and tireless rage), though the barbarian must spend 1 additional round of rage per round if her companion begins or ends its turn adjacent to her, and 2 additional rounds of rage per round if not.
ferocious_beast.name: Ferocious Beast

ferocious_mount.description: Ferocious Mount: While raging and mounted, the barbarian's mount also gains the benefits of rage (including greater rage and mighty rage) as long as the barbarian is mounted or adjacent to it. While her mount is raging in this way, she must spend one additional round of rage per round. She can elect not to pay this cost, in which case her mount does not rage.
ferocious_mount.name: Ferocious Mount

ferocious_trample.description: Ferocious Trample: While raging and mounted, the barbarian's mount gains the trample special attack. This attack inflicts 1d8 points of damage for a Medium mount, 2d6 for a Large mount, or 2d8 for a Huge mount, plus 1-1/2 times the mount's Strength modifier. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the mount's Strength modifier) halves this damage.~~~Creatures in the mount's path or that threaten squares it passes through may make attacks of opportunity against either the barbarian or the mount, but not both. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, ferocious mount)
ferocious_trample.name: Ferocious Trample

fey_blood.description: Fey Blood: While raging, when the barbarian charges, she ignores difficult terrain (including magical terrain, but not other creatures). (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser fey blood)
fey_blood.name: Fey Blood

fiend_totem.description: Fiend Totem: While raging, the barbarian sprouts dozens of wicked barbs from her body. Anyone striking the barbarian with a melee weapon, an unarmed strike, or a natural weapon takes 1d6 points of piercing damage. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser fiend totem)
fiend_totem.name: Fiend Totem

fierce_fortitude.description: Fierce Fortitude: The character gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against diseases and poison. (Prerequisite: Trained in Intimidate)
fierce_fortitude.name: Fierce Fortitude

fire_totem.description: Fire Totem: While the barbarian is raging, any opponent that confirms a critical hit against her with a piercing or slashing melee weapon is sprayed with liquid fire. (Creatures with reach weapons are immune.) The attacker takes 1d6 points of fire damage per barbarian level (Reflex halves; DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Con modifier). (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser elemental totem (fire))
fire_totem.name: Fire Totem

fjord_linnorm_death_curse.description:
The character channels the power of a fjord linnorm. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of cold damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed by an attack or spell, the attacker suffers the curse of drowning (Will negates)." prereq="4th-level barbarian"

Curse of Drowning: Curse; save Will DC 10 + 1/2 the character's level + their Charisma modifier; effect Target is unable to breathe water (even with magic), can hold its breath only half as long as normal, and is sickened whenever it holds its breath
fjord_linnorm_death_curse.name: Fjord Linnorm Death Curse

flesh_wound.description: Flesh Wound: Once per rage, the barbarian can try to avoid serious harm from an attack. The barbarian must make a Fortitude save with a DC equal to the damage that would be dealt by the attack. The barbarian's armor check penalty applies on this saving throw. If the save succeeds, the barbarian takes half damage from the attack and the damage is nonlethal. The barbarian must elect to use this ability after the attack roll is made, but before the damage is rolled. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian)
flesh_wound.name: Flesh Wound

flight_response.description: Flight Response: When a barbarian attempts a saving throw against a fear effect, she can enter a rage (as long as she would normally be able to enter rage). This consumes 3 rounds of the barbarian's daily allotment of rage rounds, but the barbarian can maintain the rage each round on her turn normally. Any benefits from the barbarian's rage apply immediately, so she gains her bonus on Will saves against the effect that required the initial saving throw. Unlike most rage powers, this rage power's effects are useful only when the barbarian is not raging, so a skald can't grant this rage power to allies with raging song.
flight_response.name: Flight Response

fueled_by_vengeance.description: Fueled by Vengeance: While raging, whenever you deal weapon damage to a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn, add 1 round to your remaining number of rounds of rage for the current day. You can gain no more than 1 extra round of rage each round. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, wereboar-kin or associated with wereboar-kin)
fueled_by_vengeance.name: Fueled by Vengeance

furious_barrage.description: Furious Barrage: The barbarian is treated as having the Rapid Shot feat, but only for the purpose of attacking with thrown weapons. She need not meet the feat's prerequisites. (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian, furious draw)
furious_barrage.name: Furious Barrage

furious_draw.description: Furious Draw: The barbarian is treated as having the Quick Draw feat.
furious_draw.name: Furious Draw

gearbreaker.description: Gearbreaker: Once per round while raging, whenever the barbarian makes an attack against a construct, she can ignore an amount of that construct's hardness equal to her barbarian level. This ability must be used before the attack roll is made. This power stacks with the hard hitter ability from the Numerian liberator archetype. (Prerequisite: Smasher)
gearbreaker.name: Gearbreaker

ghost_rager.description: Ghost Rager: While raging, the barbarian deals normal damage to incorporeal creatures even when using nonmagical weapons. She also gains a morale bonus to touch AC equal to 2 + one-fourth of her barbarian level. This can't raise her touch AC above her full AC. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian)
ghost_rager.name: Ghost Rager

good_for_what_ails_you.description: Good for What Ails You: While raging, the barbarian who takes a drink of alcohol may attempt a new saving throw against one of the following conditions that may be affecting her: blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, exhausted, fatigued, frightened, nauseated, panicked, shaken, or sickened. If she succeeds at the save, the effect is suppressed for the duration of the rage. She also may attempt a new saving throw if poisoned; a successful save counts against those required for a cure, but a failed save has no ill effect.
good_for_what_ails_you.name: Good for What Ails You

greater_abyssal_blood.description: Greater Abyssal Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains resistance 5 to acid, cold, and fire. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, abyssal blood)
greater_abyssal_blood.name: Greater Abyssal Blood

greater_air_totem.description: Greater Air Totem: While raging, the barbarian is surrounded by an aura of howling winds. Creatures attempting to cast spells while adjacent to the barbarian must succeed at a concentration check (DC 15 + spell level), and ranged attack rolls against the barbarian take a -4 penalty.~~~Creatures smaller than the barbarian that attack the barbarian in melee with a natural weapon or touch attack must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Constitution modifier) or the attack fails and the creature is flung back 5 feet and knocked prone. The barbarian can suspend this aura as a free action. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, air totem)
greater_air_totem.name: Greater Air Totem

greater_ancestor_totem.description: Greater Ancestor Totem: The barbarian's insight bonus to her chosen skill increases to +6. Once per rage, she can spend one round of rage to reroll a skill check in the chosen skill. She must take the result of the second roll, even if it is lower. (Prerequisite: Ancestor totem, 10th-level barbarian)
greater_ancestor_totem.name: Greater Ancestor Totem

greater_animal_fury.description: Greater Animal Fury: This power works as animal fury, but the barbarian's bite attack deals damage as if she were one size category larger. (Prerequisite: Animal fury)
greater_animal_fury.name: Greater Animal Fury

greater_atavism_totem.description: Greater Atavism Totem: The barbarian gains trample. (Prerequisite: Atavism totem, 10th-level barbarian)
greater_atavism_totem.name: Greater Atavism Totem

greater_beast_totem.description: Greater Beast Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains the pounce special ability, allowing her to make a full attack at the end of a charge. In addition, the damage from her claws increases to 1d8 (1d6 if Small) and the claws deal ×3 damage on a critical hit. (Prerequisite: Beast totem, 10th-level barbarian)
greater_beast_totem.name: Greater Beast Totem

greater_brawler.description: Greater Brawler: While raging, the barbarian is treated as if she has Two-Weapon Fighting when making unarmed strike attacks. (Prerequisite: Brawler)
greater_brawler.name: Greater Brawler

greater_celestial_blood.description: Greater Celestial Blood: Once per rage, the barbarian can reroll one ability check, skill check, or saving throw she just made. She must take the second result, even if it's lower. She must decide to use this ability after the die is rolled but before results are revealed. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, celestial blood)
greater_celestial_blood.name: Greater Celestial Blood

greater_celestial_totem.description: Greater Celestial Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains spell resistance equal to 11 + the barbarian's class level against spells with the evil descriptor. She also gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against spells and effects from evil creatures. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, celestial totem)
greater_celestial_totem.name: Greater Celestial Totem

greater_chaos_totem.description: Greater Chaos Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains DR/lawful equal to 1/2 her barbarian level. Her weapons and natural weapons are considered chaotic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, chaos totem)
greater_chaos_totem.name: Greater Chaos Totem

greater_cult_totem.description: Greater Cult Totem: While the barbarian is raging, when she takes hit point damage that would render her dying or dead, she remains conscious and raging until the end of her next turn after taking that damage, though she is disabled during that turn. She becomes dying or dead at the end of her next turn as normal for her current hit point total. This ability has no effect if the barbarian dies from a cause other than hit point damage, such as from a death effect or if her Constitution damage exceeds her Constitution score. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, lesser cult totem, cult totem)
greater_cult_totem.name: Greater Cult Totem

greater_daemon_totem.description: Greater Daemon Totem: If the barbarian kills an intelligent creature with a CR equal to at least half her character level while raging, she heals 5 hit points. If she is already at her maximum number of hit points, she instead gains 5 temporary hit points, which don't stack if she kills multiple creatures. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, lesser daemon totem, daemon totem)
greater_daemon_totem.name: Greater Daemon Totem

greater_draconic_blood.description: Greater Draconic Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains a breath weapon that she can use once per day. For every 2 barbarian levels, this breath weapon deals 1d6 points of damage of the energy type she choose for the draconic blood power, either in a 30-foot cone (if cold or fire) or a 60-foot line (if acid or electricity). Those caught in the area of the breath can attempt a Reflex saving throw for half damage. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + her Constitution modifier. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, draconic blood)
greater_draconic_blood.name: Greater Draconic Blood

greater_earth_totem.description: Greater Earth Totem: While raging, the barbarian's skin becomes as hard as stone. If the barbarian is hit with a manufactured weapon while raging, the weapon takes an amount of damage equal to half that dealt to the barbarian (ignoring damage reduction). (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, earth totem)
greater_earth_totem.name: Greater Earth Totem

greater_eclipsing_rage.description: Greater Eclipsing Rage: Whenever the barbarian rages, the light level within 20 feet of her lowers by two steps instead of one. She still can't decrease the light level below normal darkness with this ability. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, eclipsing rage)
greater_eclipsing_rage.name: Greater Eclipsing Rage

greater_elemental_blood.description: Greater Elemental Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains a special movement type or bonus based on her chosen element: acid grants a burrow speed of 30 feet, cold grants a swim speed of 60 feet, fire grants an increase of 30 feet to her base land speed, and electricity grants a fly speed of 60 feet (good maneuverability). (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, elemental blood)
greater_elemental_blood.name: Greater Elemental Blood

greater_elemental_rage.description: Greater Elemental Rage: While raging, all of the barbarian's critical hits made with melee weapons deal an additional 1d10 points of energy damage (2d10 if the weapon deals ×3 damage on a critical hit, 3d10 if the weapon deals ×4 on a critical hit). The type of this damage is the same as the type chosen for the elemental rage power. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, elemental rage)
greater_elemental_rage.name: Greater Elemental Rage

greater_energy_resistance.description: Greater Energy Resistance: Once per rage, a barbarian can reduce damage by half from a single attack against which she has energy resistance (halve the damage, then apply resistance). (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, energy resistance)
greater_energy_resistance.name: Greater Energy Resistance

greater_erratic_charge.description: Greater Erratic Charge: The barbarian can move 10 feet when using erratic charge. If she does so, the creature she is charging must be at least 20 feet away and the movement reduces the maximum distance of her charge by 20 feet. (Prerequisite: Erratic charge)
greater_erratic_charge.name: Greater Erratic Charge

greater_ferocious_beast.description: Greater Ferocious Beast: While the barbarian is raging, her animal companion shares the benefits of the barbarian's rage powers that are constant in effect. It gains no benefit from rage powers that require actions to activate, even if they are free actions. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, ferocious beast)
greater_ferocious_beast.name: Greater Ferocious Beast

greater_ferocious_mount.description: Greater Ferocious Mount: While raging and mounted, the barbarian's mount gains the benefits of any rage powers that are constant in effect when the barbarian is raging. It does not gain the benefit of any rage powers that require actions to activate, even if they are free actions. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, ferocious mount)
greater_ferocious_mount.name: Greater Ferocious Mount

greater_ferocious_trample.description: Greater Ferocious Trample: A barbarian's mount can affect creatures up to its own size with its ferocious trample. In addition, it can make an overrun combat maneuver check as a free action against a creature that fails its Reflex save (or chooses not to save in order to take an attack of opportunity) against its trample. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, ferocious trample)
greater_ferocious_trample.name: Greater Ferocious Trample

greater_fey_blood.description: Greater Fey Blood: While raging, as long as the barbarian moves at least 10 feet, she gain the effects of blur for 1 round. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, fey blood)
greater_fey_blood.name: Greater Fey Blood

greater_fiend_totem.description: Greater Fiend Totem: While raging, the barbarian is surrounded by an aura of menace. Good creatures adjacent to the barbarian are shaken and take 2d6 points of slashing damage at the beginning of the barbarian's turn as dozens of small cuts open across their flesh. Neutral creatures that are adjacent to the barbarian are shaken, but do not take any damage. Evil creatures are unaffected. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, fiend totem)
greater_fiend_totem.name: Greater Fiend Totem

greater_fire_totem.description: Greater Fire Totem: While raging, the barbarian can envelope herself in a cloud of smoke that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere and follows her as she moves. Creatures in the affected area must succeed at Fortitude saves each round or suffer the effects of breathing heavy smoke. The barbarian is immune to the smoke's effects, including vision obstruction. She can end this smoke as a free action, or it can be dispersed by wind in the same manner as a fog cloud spell. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, fire totem)
greater_fire_totem.name: Greater Fire Totem

greater_ground_breaker.description: Greater Ground Breaker: When using the ground breaker rage power, the barbarian can extend the radius of the effect by 5 feet. This rage power can be selected up to three times, and its effects stack. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, ground breaker)
greater_ground_breaker.name: Greater Ground Breaker

greater_guarded_life.description: Greater Guarded Life: When using the guarded life rage power, 1 additional hit point of lethal damage per barbarian level is converted to nonlethal damage. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, guarded life)
greater_guarded_life.name: Greater Guarded Life

greater_hurling.description: Greater Hurling: As hurling, but the barbarian can increase the range increment to 30 feet or increase the size of a hurled object by two size categories. (Prerequisite: Hurling, 12th-level barbarian)
greater_hurling.name: Greater Hurling

greater_infernal_blood.description: Greater Infernal Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains a +4 bonus against enchantment and fear effects. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, infernal blood)
greater_infernal_blood.name: Greater Infernal Blood

greater_moon_totem.description: Greater Moon Totem: While raging, the barbarian ignores the miss chance for concealment and treats total concealment as concealment. (Prerequisite: Moon totem, 10th-level barbarian)
greater_moon_totem.name: Greater Moon Totem

greater_psychopomp_totem.description: Greater Psychopomp Totem: While raging, the barbarian can detect and locate undead creatures within 30 feet, just as if it had the blindsight ability, and any weapons she wields are treated as if they had the ghost touch special ability. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, psychopomp totem)
greater_psychopomp_totem.name: Greater Psychopomp Totem

greater_spire_totem.description: Greater Spire Totem: While the barbarian is raging, all allies within 30 feet gain a +2 morale bonus on Will saves. When attempting a Will save against a fear effect, all allies within this area can roll twice and use the better result. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, spire totem)
greater_spire_totem.name: Greater Spire Totem

greater_spirit_totem.description: Greater Spirit Totem: While raging, the spirits that surround the barbarian become dangerous to any enemy adjacent to the barbarian. Living enemies adjacent to the barbarian at the start of her turn take 1d8 points of negative energy damage. In addition, the spirit wisps can now attack foes that are up to 15 feet away from the barbarian and the slam attack deals 1d6 points of negative energy damage. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, spirit totem)
greater_spirit_totem.name: Greater Spirit Totem

greater_suffocating_grip.description: Greater Suffocating Grip: When the barbarian is using the suffocating grip rage power, the grappled creature cannot hold its breath and immediately begins suffocating. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, suffocating grip)
greater_suffocating_grip.name: Greater Suffocating Grip

greater_sun_totem.description: Greater Sun Totem: The barbarian takes on aspects of the sun. She gains fire resistance 20 when raging. While raging, she is surrounded by a halo of flame that deals 1d6 points of fire damage to anyone that hits her with a touch attack or unarmed attack or succeeds at a bull rush, drag, or grapple combat maneuver against her. Her unarmed strikes and attacks with natural weapons deal 1d6 additional points of fire damage. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, sun totem)
greater_sun_totem.name: Greater Sun Totem

greater_tyrant_totem.description: Greater Tyrant Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains swallow whole as per the universal monster rule. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian, tyrant totem)
greater_tyrant_totem.name: Greater Tyrant Totem

greater_undead_blood.description: Greater Undead Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains cold resistance 10, as well as DR 10/- against nonlethal damage. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, undead blood)
greater_undead_blood.name: Greater Undead Blood

greater_water_totem.description: Greater Water Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains tremorsense to a range of 30 feet while underwater. She can attack and move underwater as if affected by freedom of movement. (Prerequisite: 10th-level barbarian, water totem)
greater_water_totem.name: Greater Water Totem

ground_breaker.description: Ground Breaker: The barbarian can attack the floor around her. This attack automatically hits and deals damage normally. If the barbarian manages to deal more damage than the floor's hardness, the space she occupies and all of the squares adjacent to her become difficult terrain. Creatures in these squares, except the barbarian, must make a DC 15 Reflex save or be knocked prone. (Once per rage) (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian)
ground_breaker.name: Ground Breaker

guarded_life.description: Guarded Life: While raging, if the barbarian is reduced below 0 hit points, 1 hit point of lethal damage per barbarian level is converted to nonlethal damage. If the barbarian is at negative hit points due to lethal damage, she immediately stabilizes.
guarded_life.name: Guarded Life

guarded_stance.description: Guarded Stance: The barbarian gains a dodge bonus to her Armor Class against melee attacks for a number of rounds equal to the barbarian's current Constitution modifier (minimum 1). This dodge bonus is equal to 1 + one-sixth her barbarian level.
guarded_stance.name: Guarded Stance

guarded_stance_stance.description: Guarded Stance: The barbarian can take on a more defensive posture. This grants her a dodge bonus to her Armor Class for the duration of her current rage. @B-4f1-barbarian.
guarded_stance_stance.name: Guarded Stance

hissing_rage.description:
Once per hour, the barbarian can spit venom at an adjacent enemy. She must make a touch attack to successfully spit on a foe in this way, but she can also apply this poison as a swift action when she hits with a bite attack.

Hissing Rage Poison: Bite-contact or injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + their Con modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str damage; cure 2 consecutive saves
hissing_rage.name: Hissing Rage

hive_totem.description: Hive Totem: While raging, the barbarian takes half damage from attacks by swarms of vermin, including spells and effects that act like a swarm of vermin (like summon swarm used to summon spiders or insect plague).~~~She also gains a bonus on Strength ability checks and to CMD against bull rush, drag, and trip attacks equal to one-fourth of her barbarian level. (Prerequisite: Animal fury, 4th-level barbarian)
hive_totem.name: Hive Totem

hive_totem_resilience.description: Hive Totem Resilience: While raging, the barbarian takes no damage from attacks by swarms of vermin, preventing harmful secondary effects of such attacks like poison or bleed. She also gains a bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD when grappling equal to one-fourth of her barbarian level. (Prerequisite: Hive totem, 6th-level barbarian)
hive_totem_resilience.name: Hive Totem Resilience

hive_totem_toxicity.description: Hive Totem Toxicity: While raging, the barbarian increases her bite damage die type with the animal fury rage power by one die type and decreases the penalty on attack rolls with that bite to -2. Once per rage, a bite that hits can deliver an injury toxin that has a frequency of once per round for 4 rounds, deals 1d3 points of Constitution damage, and has a cure of one save. The saving throw has a Fortitude save DC of 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Constitution modifier. (Prerequisite: Hive totem, hive totem resilience, 8th-level barbarian)
hive_totem_toxicity.name: Hive Totem Toxicity

hshurhas_veil.description: Hshurha's Veil: When raging, the barbarian can use Stealth, and she gains a bonus equal to 1/2 her barbarian level on Stealth checks plus the benefits of concealment against ranged attacks and attacks of opportunity.
hshurhas_veil.name: Hshurha's Veil

hurling.description: Hurling: As lesser hurling, but the barbarian can increase the range increment to 20 feet or increase the size of a hurled object by one size category. (Prerequisite: Lesser hurling, 8th-level barbarian)
hurling.name: Hurling

hurling_charge.description: Hurling Charge: While raging and making a charge attack, the barbarian may draw and throw a hurled weapon during her charge, gaining the normal +2 attack roll bonus on the thrown weapon attack as well as on the melee attack at the end of the charge. The barbarian must move at least 10 feet before using a thrown weapon and at least 10 additional feet before making a melee attack at the end of her charge. The barbarian must have a thrown weapon in hand or have one hand free at the beginning of her charge. (Prerequisite: Lesser hurling, 6th-level barbarian)
hurling_charge.name: Hurling Charge

ice_linnorm_death_curse.description:
The character channels the power of an ice linnorm. The character's melee attacks deal an additional 1 point of cold damage. If the character is knocked unconscious or killed, the attacker suffers the curse of frost." prereq="4th-level barbarian"

Curse of Frost: Curse; save Will DC 10 + 1/2 the character's level + their Charisma modifier; effect Target gains vulnerability to cold
ice_linnorm_death_curse.name: Ice Linnorm Death Curse

impelling_disarm.description: Impelling Disarm: The barbarian can make a disarm attempt against a target in place of a melee attack. This attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity.~~~If successful, the barbarian sends the target's weapon flying - either straight at the target, or spinning away to strike another foe up to 20 feet away. This ranged attack has a -4 penalty, as it is treated as throwing a weapon that isn't designed to be thrown, even if the weapon disarmed is a thrown weapon.~~~The barbarian makes a ranged attack, which doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity, at either the target of his disarm maneuver or another creature within 20 feet. If the barbarian is aiming for the disarmed creature, the foe doesn't count as being in melee for determining any penalty on the ranged attack from throwing a ranged weapon into melee. If the ranged attack hits, the disarmed weapon deals damage as if the barbarian had thrown it. The barbarian can choose to aim the disarmed weapon at a square rather than at a foe. (Once per rage) (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian)
impelling_disarm.name: Impelling Disarm

increased_damage_reduction.description: Increased Damage Reduction: The barbarian's damage reduction increases by 1/-. This increase is always active while the barbarian is raging. A barbarian can select this rage power up to three times. Its effects stack. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian)
increased_damage_reduction.name: Increased Damage Reduction

infernal_blood.description: Infernal Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains fire resistance 5, as well as a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser infernal blood)
infernal_blood.name: Infernal Blood

inspire_ferocity.description: Inspire Ferocity: While raging, the barbarian can impart her reckless abandon modifier to all willing allies within 30 feet for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). (Prerequisite: Reckless abandon)
inspire_ferocity.name: Inspire Ferocity

internal_fortitude.description: Internal Fortitude: While raging, the barbarian is immune to the sickened and nauseated conditions. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian)
internal_fortitude.name: Internal Fortitude

intimidating_glare.description: Intimidating Glare: The barbarian can make an Intimidate check against one adjacent foe. If the barbarian successfully demoralizes her opponent, the foe is shaken for 1d4 rounds + 1 round for every 5 points by which the barbarian's check exceeds the DC.
intimidating_glare.name: Intimidating Glare

inured_to_the_dead.description: Inured to the Dead: Once per rage, when the barbarian fails a saving throw against an effect created by an undead creature, she can reroll the saving throw. She must use the second result, even if it is worse. This does not require spending an action. (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian)
inured_to_the_dead.name: Inured to the Dead

kelizandris_tide.description: Kelizandri's Tide: Once per day after attempting this maneuver, she can attack each adjacent creature as if using the Whirlwind Attack feat. If she has the Whirlwind Attack feat, she can also use it as a free action in this way one additional time per day. The barbarian can attempt a single combat maneuver check against each creature within 10 feet of her. If her roll equals or exceeds a creature's CMD, she moves that creature 5 feet closer to her.
kelizandris_tide.name: Kelizandri's Tide

knockback.description: Knockback: Once per round, the barbarian can make a bull rush attempt against one target in place of a melee attack. If successful, the target takes damage equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier and is moved back as normal. The barbarian does not need to move with the target if successful.
knockback.name: Knockback

knockdown.description: Knockdown: Once per rage, the barbarian can make a trip attack against one target in place of a melee attack. If successful, the target takes damage equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier and is knocked prone.
knockdown.name: Knockdown

knockdown_stance.description: Knockdown Stance: The barbarian can focus on toppling her foes. Once per round, she can make a trip attack against one target in place of a melee attack. If she succeeds, the target is knocked prone.
knockdown_stance.name: Knockdown Stance

lesser_abyssal_blood.description: Lesser Abyssal Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains two claw attacks. These attacks are considered primary attacks and are made at the barbarian's full base attack bonus. They deal 1d6 points of slashing damage for Medium creatures (1d4 if Small) plus her Strength modifier.
lesser_abyssal_blood.name: Lesser Abyssal Blood

lesser_ancestor_totem.description: Lesser Ancestor Totem: When she enters a rage, the barbarian selects a skill of her choice, which must be one she can use while raging, such as Climb or Intimidate. While raging, she gains a +2 insight bonus to the chosen skill.
lesser_ancestor_totem.name: Lesser Ancestor Totem

lesser_atavism_totem.description: Lesser Atavism Totem: The barbarian gains a bite attack; if she already has a bite attack, it deals damage as if the barbarian were one size larger.
lesser_atavism_totem.name: Lesser Atavism Totem

lesser_beast_totem.description: Lesser Beast Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains two claw attacks. These attacks are considered primary attacks and are made at the barbarian's full base attack bonus. The claws deal 1d6 points of slashing damage (1d4 if Small) plus the barbarian's Strength modifier.
lesser_beast_totem.name: Lesser Beast Totem

lesser_celestial_blood.description: Lesser Celestial Blood: While raging, the barbarian's melee attacks are considered good-aligned weapons for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction. Furthermore, the barbarian deals an additional 1d6 points of damage when she damages an evil outsider with a melee attack.
lesser_celestial_blood.name: Lesser Celestial Blood

lesser_celestial_totem.description: Lesser Celestial Totem: While raging, the barbarian benefits from increased magical healing. Whenever she is subject to a spell that cures hit point damage, she heals 1 additional point of damage per caster level. In the case of non-spell healing effects (such as channeled energy or lay on hands), she heals a number of additional points equal to the class level of the character performing the magical healing. This does not affect fast healing or regeneration.
lesser_celestial_totem.name: Lesser Celestial Totem

lesser_chaos_totem.description: Lesser Chaos Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC against the attacks of lawful creatures and a +1 resistance bonus on saving throws against confusion, insanity, polymorph, and effects with the lawful descriptor. This bonus increases by +1 for each chaos totem rage power she possesses.
lesser_chaos_totem.name: Lesser Chaos Totem

lesser_cult_totem.description: Lesser Cult Totem: While the barbarian is raging, any morale bonuses or bonuses for flanking she gains on attacks rolls are added to her damage rolls instead of her attack rolls. They are still morale bonuses, and they don't stack with other morale bonuses on damage rolls.
lesser_cult_totem.name: Lesser Cult Totem

lesser_daemon_totem.description: Lesser Daemon Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against acid damage, death effects, disease, and poison. This bonus increases by 1 for each daemon totem rage power the barbarian has, excluding this one.
lesser_daemon_totem.name: Lesser Daemon Totem

lesser_draconic_blood.description: Lesser Draconic Blood: While raging, the barbarian gains two claw attacks. These attacks are considered primary attacks and are made at the barbarian's full base attack bonus. They deal 1d6 points of slashing damage for Medium creatures (1d4 if Small) plus her Strength modifier.
lesser_draconic_blood.name: Lesser Draconic Blood

lesser_elemental_blood.description: Lesser Elemental Blood: While raging, the barbarian can imbue her melee attacks with elemental energy, dealing an additional 1d6 points of damage of the chosen energy type for 1 round. (3 times/day)
lesser_elemental_blood.name: Lesser Elemental Blood

lesser_elemental_rage.description: Lesser Elemental Rage: The barbarian can cause her melee attacks to deal an additional 1d6 points of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) for 1 round. (Once per rage) (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian)
lesser_elemental_rage.name: Lesser Elemental Rage

lesser_elemental_totem.description: Lesser Elemental Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains a bonus on saving throws against spells with the selected elemental descriptor. @B-4f1-barbarian. The barbarian gains access to the elemental totem rage power matching the element she selected.
lesser_elemental_totem.name: Lesser Elemental Totem

lesser_fey_blood.description: Lesser Fey Blood: While raging, each time the barbarian confirms a critical hit, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + her Constitution modifier) or be confused for one round. This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect.
lesser_fey_blood.name: Lesser Fey Blood

lesser_fiend_totem.description: Lesser Fiend Totem: While raging, the barbarian grows a pair of large horns, gaining a gore attack. This attack is a primary attack (unless she is also attacking with weapons, in which case it is a secondary attack) and is made at the barbarian's full base attack bonus (-5 if it is a secondary attack). The gore attack deals 1d8 points of piercing damage (1d6 if Small) plus the barbarian's Strength modifier (1/2 if it is a secondary attack).
lesser_fiend_totem.name: Lesser Fiend Totem

lesser_hurling.description: Lesser Hurling: While raging, the barbarian can lift and hurl an object up to one size category smaller than herself with both hands or two size categories smaller with one hand as an improvised weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. This inflicts damage as a falling object plus the barbarian's Strength bonus. This damage is halved if the object is not made of stone, metal, or similar material. This is a ranged touch attack, and the target may attempt a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) for half damage. The barbarian may apply Power Attack to this attack as a one- or two-handed weapon, as appropriate.
lesser_hurling.name: Lesser Hurling

lesser_infernal_blood.description: Lesser Infernal Blood: While raging, the barbarian can infuse her attacks with hellfire for 1 round. During this time, all of her melee attacks gain the flaming magic weapon special ability. (3 times/day)
lesser_infernal_blood.name: Lesser Infernal Blood

lesser_moon_totem.description: Lesser Moon Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If the barbarian already has darkvision, the range of her darkvision increases by 30 feet while she is raging.
lesser_moon_totem.name: Lesser Moon Totem

lesser_psychopomp_totem.description: Lesser Psychopomp Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC against the attacks of undead creatures and a +1 bonus on saving throws against death effects, diseases, and poisons. This bonus increases by 1 for each psychopomp totem rage power she has, excepting this one.
lesser_psychopomp_totem.name: Lesser Psychopomp Totem

lesser_spire_totem.description: Lesser Spire Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains a +1 morale bonus on attacks against any creature that has targeted one of her allies with an attack or a harmful spell within the last round.
lesser_spire_totem.name: Lesser Spire Totem

lesser_spirit_totem.description: Lesser Spirit Totem: While raging, the barbarian is surrounded by spirit wisps that harass her foes. These spirits make one slam attack each round against a living foe that is adjacent to the barbarian. This slam attack is made using the barbarian's full base attack bonus, plus the barbarian's Charisma modifier. The slam deals 1d4 points of negative energy damage, plus the barbarian's Charisma modifier.
lesser_spirit_totem.name: Lesser Spirit Totem

lesser_sun_totem.description: Lesser Sun Totem: The sun's fire invigorates the barbarian. She is immune to environmental effects from heat and severe heat, and she gains a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves against the effects of extreme heat. In addition, the barbarian gains fire resistance 5 while raging.
lesser_sun_totem.name: Lesser Sun Totem

lesser_tyrant_totem.description: Lesser Tyrant Totem: While raging, the barbarian's bite attack deals damage as if the barbarian were one size larger than her actual size. (Prerequisite: Animal fury rage power or a natural bite attack)
lesser_tyrant_totem.name: Lesser Tyrant Totem

lesser_undead_blood.description: Lesser Undead Blood: While raging, when the barbarian hits a creature with a charge attack, the creature she hit becomes shaken for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 her barbarian level (minimum 1). This effect does not stack with other fear effects to cause a stronger condition.
lesser_undead_blood.name: Lesser Undead Blood

lethal_accuracy.description: Lethal Accuracy: When using her surprise accuracy rage power, the barbarian's critical multiplier for damage increases by 1 (a ×2 multiplier becomes ×3, a 19-20/×2 multiplier becomes 19-20/×3, a ×3 multiplier becomes ×4, and a ×4 multiplier becomes ×5). (Prerequisite: 16th-level barbarian, surprise accuracy, deadly accuracy)
lethal_accuracy.name: Lethal Accuracy

liquid_courage.description: Liquid Courage: While raging, the barbarian increases her morale bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects by +1 for each alcoholic drink she consumes during her rage, to a maximum of +1 increase per four barbarian levels.
liquid_courage.name: Liquid Courage

lizard_stride.description: Lizard Stride: When the barbarian makes a charge or run action while raging, she can move across the surface of water without sinking. She sinks immediately if she ends her turn standing on water.
lizard_stride.name: Lizard Stride

low_light_vision.description: Low-Light Vision: The barbarian's senses sharpen and she gains low-light vision while raging.
low_light_vision.name: Low-Light Vision

master_of_the_deep.description: Master of the Deep: The barbarian commands an aquatic creature to do her bidding. The barbarian selects a creature with the aquatic type within 30 feet and gives a terse command from those listed in the command spell. Alternatively, if the creature has an Intelligence of 1 or 2, the barbarian may instead command the creature to attack the closest creature to it. The creature must succeed at a Will save (DC equal to 10 + half the barbarian's level + her Strength modifier) or obey the command to the best of its ability on its next turn. Once a creature has attempted a saving throw against master of the deep (successful or not), it is immune to this power for 24 hours. This ability is a mind-affecting effect, but it is not language dependent; the creature need not understand the barbarian giving the command. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian)
master_of_the_deep.name: Master of the Deep

mighty_swing.description: Mighty Swing: The barbarian automatically confirms a critical hit. This power can be used once a critical threat has been determined. This power can only be used once per rage. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian)
mighty_swing.name: Mighty Swing

moment_of_clarity.description: Moment of Clarity: The barbarian does not gain any benefits or take any of the penalties from rage for 1 round. This includes the penalty to Armor Class and the restriction on what actions can be performed. This round still counts against her total number of rounds of rage per day. (Once per rage)
moment_of_clarity.name: Moment of Clarity

moon_totem.description: Moon Totem: While raging, the barbarian gains a bonus equal to half her level on Perception checks to pinpoint the location of an unseen creature, and unseen attackers gain no bonus on attacks against the barbarian. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser moon totem)
moon_totem.name: Moon Totem

night_vision.description: Night Vision: The barbarian's senses grow incredibly sharp while raging and she gains darkvision 60 feet. (Prerequisite: Low-light vision rage power or a low-light vision racial trait)
night_vision.name: Night Vision

no_escape.description: No Escape: When an adjacent foe uses a withdraw action to move away from her, the barbarian can move up to double her normal speed. She must end her movement adjacent to the enemy that used the withdraw action. The barbarian provokes attacks of opportunity as normal during this movement. (Once per rage)
no_escape.name: No Escape

overbearing_advance.description: Overbearing Advance: While raging, the barbarian inflicts damage equal to her Strength bonus whenever she succeeds at an overrun combat maneuver.
overbearing_advance.name: Overbearing Advance

overbearing_onslaught.description: Overbearing Onslaught: While raging, the barbarian may overrun more than one target per round, with a -2 penalty on her CMB for each overrun check after the first. (Prerequisite: Overbearing advance, 6th-level barbarian)
overbearing_onslaught.name: Overbearing Onslaught

pack_rage.description: Pack Rage: When a barbarian with this rage power enters a rage, any barbarian within 30 feet who also has this rage power can enter a rage. A barbarian that enters a rage outside of her turn spends 1 round of rage immediately and then spends another round of rage to maintain her rage at the beginning of her next turn. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian)
pack_rage.name: Pack Rage

penetrating_bite.description: Penetrating Bite: When using the animal fury rage power while raging, the barbarian's bite is able to pierce most resistances. (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian, animal fury) At 4th level: Her bite is treated as a magic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 7th level: Her bite is also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 10th level: Her bite is also treated as a chaotic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 16th level: Her bite is treated as an adamantine weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness.
penetrating_bite.name: Penetrating Bite

perfect_clarity.description: Perfect Clarity: While using her moment of clarity rage power, the barbarian can roll twice for any miss chance or Will saving throws to disbelieve illusions, taking the better result. (Prerequisite: Moment of clarity)
perfect_clarity.name: Perfect Clarity

powerful_blow.description: Powerful Blow: The barbarian gains a bonus on a single damage roll. @B-4f1-barbarian. This power is used before the roll to hit is made. (Once per rage)
powerful_blow.name: Powerful Blow

powerful_stance.description: Powerful Stance: The barbarian can focus her ferocity. She gains a bonus on melee damage rolls and thrown weapon damage rolls. @B-4f1-barbarian.
powerful_stance.name: Powerful Stance

primal_scent.description: Primal Scent: When using her scent rage power, the barbarian adds half her barbarian level on Survival checks made to track by scent and on Perception checks to pinpoint the location of creatures she cannot see.~~~If she pinpoints the location of a creature that has total concealment, she treats it as having concealment. (Prerequisite: 8th-level barbarian, scent)
primal_scent.name: Primal Scent

psychopomp_totem.description: Psychopomp Totem: The first time each round a creature with regeneration or fast healing is struck by the barbarian while she is raging, the creature must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + half the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) or that ability is suppressed for 1 round. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, lesser psychopomp totem)
psychopomp_totem.name: Psychopomp Totem

quick_reflexes.description: Quick Reflexes: While raging, the barbarian can make one additional attack of opportunity per round.
quick_reflexes.name: Quick Reflexes

raging_climber.description: Raging Climber: When raging, the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus on all Climb skill checks.
raging_climber.name: Raging Climber

raging_flier.description: Raging Flier: Once per rage, the character can fly up to her base speed. If she uses the charge action, she can use this flight as part of her movement during the charge. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, raging leaper)
raging_flier.name: Raging Flier

raging_flyer.description: Raging Flyer: When raging, the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus to Fly checks.
raging_flyer.name: Raging Flyer

raging_grappler.description: Raging Grappler: While raging, the barbarian grapples her foes with the power and viciousness of a river crocodile. As long as she is raging, whenever the barbarian succeeds at a check to start a grapple, she can choose to deal damage as if she had also succeeded at a check to maintain the grapple.~~~In addition, while she is raging, whenever the barbarian succeeds at a combat maneuver check to maintain a grapple, she can choose to give herself, the target of her grapple, or both the prone condition as a free action while continuing to maintain the grapple.
raging_grappler.name: Raging Grappler

raging_leaper.description: Raging Leaper: When raging, the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus on all Acrobatics skill checks made to jump. When making a jump in this way, the barbarian is always considered to have a running start.
raging_leaper.name: Raging Leaper

raging_swimmer.description: Raging Swimmer: When raging, the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus on all Swim skill checks.
raging_swimmer.name: Raging Swimmer

raging_whirlwind.description: Raging Whirlwind: The barbarian can create a whirlwind with a powerful spinning move after she confirms a critical hit with a melee attack. The whirlwind circles the target of her melee attack, lifting it in the air slightly until the end of the barbarian's turn. The creature can attempt a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Constitution modifier) to negate this effect. If it fails the save, the target loses its Dexterity modifier to AC for the rest of the barbarian's turn and lands prone on the ground at the end of her turn. Raging whirlwind has no effect on flying creatures. (Prerequisite: 12th-level barbarian)
raging_whirlwind.name: Raging Whirlwind

reckless_abandon.description: Reckless Abandon: While raging, the barbarian can take a penalty to AC to gain a bonus on attack rolls. The penalty and bonus are both equal to 1 + one-fourth of her barbarian level.
reckless_abandon.name: Reckless Abandon

reckless_stance.description: Reckless Stance: The barbarian can attack with abandon at the expense of her defense. She gains a bonus on attack rolls, but takes a penalty to AC. This bonus and penalty are equal to 1 + one-fourth of her barbarian level.
reckless_stance.name: Reckless Stance

reflexive_dodge.description: Reflexive Dodge: While using her rolling dodge rage power, the barbarian may apply her dodge bonus to AC as a bonus on Reflex saving throws. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, rolling dodge)
reflexive_dodge.name: Reflexive Dodge

regenerative_stance.description: Regenerative Stance: The barbarian can continually replenish her health. At the start of her turn, she regains temporary hit points equal to one-fourth of her barbarian level, but this cannot give her more than her maximum temporary hit points from rage. (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian)
regenerative_stance.name: Regenerative Stance

regenerative_vigor.description: Regenerative Vigor: After using her renewed vigor rage power until her current rage ends, the barbarian gains fast healing equal to one-sixth of her barbarian level. She regains hit points from fast healing at the start of each of her turns. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, renewed vigor)
regenerative_vigor.name: Regenerative Vigor

renewed_life.description: Renewed Life: While raging, the barbarian ignores the effect of one temporary negative level per four barbarian levels she has (maximum 5). Once per day, when a barbarian with temporary negative levels ends her rage, she can attempt saving throws to remove a number of negative levels equal to the number of levels she could ignore while raging. (Prerequisite: 6th-level barbarian, renewed vitality)
renewed_life.name: Renewed Life

renewed_vigor.description: Renewed Vigor: The barbarian heals 1d8 points of damage + her Constitution modifier. For every four levels the barbarian has attained above 4th, this amount of damage healed increases by 1d8, to a maximum of 5d8 at 20th level. This power can be used only while raging. (Once per day) (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian)
renewed_vigor.name: Renewed Vigor

renewed_vitality.description: Renewed Vitality: While raging, the barbarian ignores the effect of 1 point of ability penalty or damage per two barbarian levels she has (maximum 10). Once per day, when a barbarian with ability penalties or damage ends her rage, she can reroll a saving throw, if any, against an effect that imposed an ability penalty or dealt her ability damage. If successful, she removes an amount of ability penalty or damage equal to the amount she can ignore while raging. (Prerequisite: 4th-level barbarian, renewed vigor)
renewed_vitality.name: Renewed Vitality

roaring_drunk.description: Roaring Drunk: While raging, the barbarian gains a +1 morale bonus on Intimidate checks and to the save DC of any fear effects she creates for each alcoholic drink she has consumed during her rage, to a maximum of +1 per four barbarian levels.
roaring_drunk.name: Roaring Drunk

rolling_dodge.description: Rolling Dodge: The barbarian gains a dodge bonus to her Armor Class against ranged attacks for a number of rounds equal to the barbarian's current Constitution modifier (minimum 1). @B-6f1-barbarian.
rolling_dodge.name: Rolling Dodge

roused_anger.description: Roused Anger: The barbarian may enter a rage even if fatigued. While raging after using this ability, the barbarian is immune to the fatigued condition. Once this rage ends, the barbarian is exhausted for 10 minutes per round spent raging.
roused_anger.name: Roused Anger

savage_dirty_trick.description:
Once per round while raging, the barbarian can attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver in place of a melee attack. If successful, the target takes an amount of damage equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier and must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) or take an additional penalty from the dirty trick based on the type of dirty trick performed and the following table.

Initial PenaltyAdditional Penalty
BlindedStaggered
DazzledDazed
DeafenedStaggered
EntangledAnchored in place and unable to move from that square
SickenedNauseated

On a failed Fortitude save, the opponent takes this additional penalty on top of the dirty trick's original effect. The additional penalty lasts for 1 round (though the initial penalty lasts as long as normal), and can be removed with a move action. The initial effect cannot be removed via mundane means until the additional penalty is removed (though magical effects like remove blindness/deafness work). Removing the initial effect also removes the additional penalty. If the target is immune to the initial penalty, then it is unaffected by the additional penalty.

For example, a barbarian using this rage power attempts a dirty trick combat maneuver against her opponent to blind him. She succeeds and her opponent fails his Fortitude save, so he becomes staggered as well as blinded. Regardless of whether he had succeeded at his saving throw, the opponent still takes an amount of damage from the barbarian's combat maneuver equal to the barbarian's Strength modifier (unless he has damage reduction or would otherwise be able to prevent this damage). Likewise, if her opponent were immune to blinding effects, he would not suffer from the blindness or the staggering effect, regardless of his saving throw.
savage_dirty_trick.name: Savage Dirty Trick
